title: POST customers/{id}/portal-session request (mint a single-use link that opens the member portal signed in; the store calls it only when a verified member clicks a portal button)

wp_user_id.description: The WordPress user the member is signed in as. Must equal the store account Pixalink holds for this member (properties.woocommerce.id).

destination.description: Portal page to open after sign-in; home when omitted.
